description: Takes a plan off sale: its Stripe price is archived and nobody can buy it any more. Everyone who bought it keeps what they bought.

plan.description: A plan id, as toolaby_get_tool lists them (the first plan is "default").

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_retire_plan
title: Retire a plan
